mangabaka_title: Do Not Be Captivated by the Peach Color

titles.title: Do Not Be Captivated by the Peach Color
Don't Be Bewitched by Peach Hues

description:
Eunha returns to Muyeong, her hometown, in search of peace of mind. But there, she comes face-to-face with Kwon Taejun, covered in blood.

She never imagined that the man who had vanished without a trace after the accident would be here.

But why is this man the color of a peach?

As though bewitched by that peach hue, Eunha finds herself swept away by Taejun. By the time realization finally strikes, she is already in far too deep.

She should never have allowed herself to be captivated by that beautiful peach color.
